fee_notes: Monthly Branding Royalty: 8% for $0-$499,999 YTD revenue; 7% for $500k-$999,999; 6% for $1M-$1.499,999; 5% for $1.5M+, tiered for first 24 months, then greater of tiered amount or $1,000 minimum. National Branding & Marketing Fee 1.5% on first $1.5M revenue annually. Digital Marketing Fee $300-$400/month. Technology Fee $490/month (up to $1,000) for CRM, intranet, email, Google Workspace, QuickBooks. Individual Advertising Investment minimum $40,000-$60,000/year to third parties. Bookkeeping Services $350/month if elected (required first 2 years). Transfer Fee $10,000. Successor Franchise Fee $4,950 or 10% of then-current fee (greater). Various other fees for audits, training, late reports, equipment upgrades, seminars.
